assets.title: TTC · UniMiB
assets.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing.
Asset type: ONE finished Italian web display advertisement for a teaching mockup of the iLMeteo website. Standalone raster artwork, not a web page, not a contact sheet. Wide billboard landscape canvas, aspect ratio 3.88:1, intended display size 970 × 250. Fill the entire image with the advertisement.
Primary request: promote the real UniMiB master's programme TTC, Teoria e Tecnologia della Comunicazione, in a fictional classroom ad campaign. Friendly ambitious university recruitment creative, clever reference to weather through the headline.
Scene/backdrop: confident midnight indigo field #312e81 with bold lime #a3e635 and white typography. Abstract visual of intersecting disciplines: a few clean geometric paths like a metro map, connected rounded blocks suggesting a conversation and an interface. A visually rich focal composition at the right, plenty of clear space for the copy at the left. Clear, confident advertising, crafted and editorial rather than a generic tech template.
Style/medium: polished professional flat graphic campaign with subtle dimensional planes, clean geometric forms and sharply typeset text. Inter-like sans serif. Excellent readability at the small display size.
Text (verbatim), visual hierarchy:
Small institution line: "Università degli Studi di Milano-Bicocca"
Very large headline: "Previsioni: idee in arrivo."
Programme acronym: "TTC"
Programme name: "Teoria e Tecnologia della Comunicazione"
Small supporting line: "Laurea magistrale"
Lime call-to-action button: "Scopri il corso"
Tiny unobtrusive bottom note: "Esempio didattico"
Constraints: all Italian copy exact and crisply spelled; no additional text. Preserve readable safe margins. No university seal, no invented institutional logo. No dates, enrolment deadlines, pricing, placement claims or promises. No iLMeteo logo, no surrounding webpage, no fake browser chrome, no borders or frame. This is a fictional ad creative for an actual course, not a claim of an official university campaign. Opaque background.

assets.title: Booklet · CVeDI
assets.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing.
Asset type: ONE finished vertical Italian web display advertisement for a teaching mockup of the iLMeteo website. Standalone raster artwork, not a website or contact sheet. Portrait canvas aspect ratio 1:2, intended display format 300 × 600. Entire canvas is the ad.
Primary request: promote the teaching booklet of Comunicazione visiva e design delle interfacce. Beautiful editorial/book advertising, distinctive, tactile and highly legible.
Scene/backdrop: warm pure white studio background with a large tasteful physical softcover book angled slightly in three-quarter view in the middle. Cover uses deep indigo #312e81, bold white geometric type, a few lime and colored metro-inspired line paths with small perpendicular station ticks. The cover is a conceptual promotional mockup, not a facsimile of an existing edition. Book has real paper edges and a neat thick spine, soft natural contact shadow beneath the physical book, no image frame.
Composition: clear black/indigo headline in the upper portion, the book as hero in the central portion, a short supporting line and lime CTA near the bottom. Calm generous spacing, sophisticated contemporary academic campaign, strong visual hierarchy. Sans serif headline with carefully balanced lines.
Text (verbatim):
Upper eyebrow: "CVeDI"
Large headline: "La teoria, a portata di pagina."
On book cover: "Booklet" and "Comunicazione visiva e design delle interfacce"
Supporting line: "Concetti, esempi e strumenti di design."
Call-to-action button: "Apri il booklet"
Tiny unobtrusive footer note: "Esempio didattico"
Constraints: exact correctly spelled Italian, no other copy or numbers. Large headline and CTA must remain legible at 300px width. Booklet is a teaching resource, do not add price, sales claims, edition year, authors or download availability promises. No university seal, no invented institutional logo. No iLMeteo logo, no web page screenshot, no browser chrome, no frame. Opaque background.

assets.title: Caffè TTC
assets.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing.
Asset type: ONE finished rectangular Italian web display advertisement, standalone raster artwork for the fictional teaching cafe Caffè TTC, to use later in an iLMeteo classroom mockup. Landscape rectangle aspect ratio 6:5, intended display size 300 × 250. Entire canvas is the advertisement.
Input image 1: identity reference only, the existing Caffè TTC espresso-cup emblem with circular handle, saucer and TWO curls of steam. Reuse its recognizable silhouette as a small emblem beside the brand name; do not redesign it. The reference is not the image to edit.
Primary request: advertise Caffè TTC as a playful interactive design lab with 21 visual styles, using the appetizing visual language of a real cafe display ad.
Scene/backdrop: rich dark forest green #214b39 background, warm cream text and restrained pale green accent. Beautiful photorealistic ceramic espresso cup with crema and a fresh golden croissant filling the lower half. Natural inviting morning light, plausible textures, no unnatural floating beans or extra props. Elegant cafe product photography paired with very clear graphic typography. The products have room to breathe and do not overlap the text.
Composition: brand line at top, bold concise headline below, product hero filling the middle and lower portion, supporting text and clear pale-green CTA integrated at the bottom. Broad safe margins, excellent small-size contrast.
Text (verbatim):
Brand name: "Caffè TTC"
Main headline: "Previsioni: pausa caffè."
Supporting line: "Un bar. 21 stili. Tutto da esplorare."
Call-to-action button: "Entra nel laboratorio"
Tiny unobtrusive bottom note: "Esempio didattico"
Constraints: Caffè must have the correct grave accent è. All copy exact and sharply readable. No menu prices, address, opening hours or real cafe claims. This is the existing fictional educational cafe, not a real venue. No extra logo, no iLMeteo logo, no borders, no external frame, no surrounding website or browser chrome. Opaque background.

assets.title: CVeDI · Corso
assets.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing.
Asset type: ONE finished rectangular Italian web display advertisement for a teaching mockup of the iLMeteo website. Standalone raster ad artwork, landscape rectangle aspect ratio 6:5, intended display size 300 × 250. Do not show an entire web page or multi-ad sheet.
Primary request: promote the real university course Comunicazione visiva e design delle interfacce, abbreviated CVeDI. Persuasive visually striking academic design-course advertisement.
Scene/backdrop: solid deep red #991b1b field, white typography and vivid mint green #11CE7E graphic accent. Contemporary graphic composition: a bold stylized composition of interface panes, typographic letterforms and routed metro-inspired paths in the bottom-right portion. Use flat visual shapes with dark red rounded outlines and subtle offset planes, no glossy 3D or extraneous tiny icons. The graphic makes the subject of visual/interface design immediately apparent.
Composition: energetic editorial hierarchy with big course acronym at top, large left-aligned headline, complete course name in a distinct secondary block, a mint call-to-action at the lower left. The artwork supports the text without obstructing it; uncluttered enough for 300 × 250px.
Text (verbatim):
Eyebrow: "UniMiB"
Course acronym: "CVeDI"
Main headline: "Dai forma alle tue idee."
Full course name: "Comunicazione visiva e design delle interfacce"
Call-to-action button: "Esplora il corso"
Tiny unobtrusive bottom note: "Esempio didattico"
Constraints: exact copy, correct capitalization CVeDI with lowercase e, no extra words, no invented logo or university seal. No dates, prices, credits, guaranteed outcomes or invented course statistics. No iLMeteo logo. No image borders, frame, surrounding website or browser UI. Opaque background.
